verdict.rationale: Notte publishes first-party integration guides for specific agent frameworks. CrewAI and the Vercel AI SDK each connect via the Notte MCP server, Claude managed agents and Claude Code drive browsers via the Notte CLI, and there is also an OpenAI CUA guide. These pages show a documented plug-in path for most of the named frameworks, though the integrations are MCP/CLI wiring guides rather than native adapter packages. Missing for 10: any LangChain integration evidence, explicit Claude Agent SDK coverage (only Claude managed agents/Claude Code are shown), native adapter libraries rather than MCP/CLI pointers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
